gaps.lead: Nobody can deny that he works hard.
gaps.explanation: deny that + clause, or deny + -ing: deny his working (formal).

accept: the reason why she was chosen
gaps.lead: They chose her for the lead role because of her voice.
gaps.sentence: Her voice was ___ for the lead role.
gaps.explanation: the reason (why/that) + clause: the reason (why) she was chosen.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: was unable to = couldn't (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to begin.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing/noun: looking forward to the holidays beginning.

gaps.lead: I last saw him in March.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect with since + point in time: haven't seen him since (March).

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I shouted at you,' he said.
gaps.explanation: apologise for doing something: apologised for shouting.
